description:
Create a 3D model of an ASTM D638 Type IV tensile specimen ('dogbone') in FreeCAD. 

Dimensions:
- Overall Length: 115 mm
- Width at Ends: 19 mm
- Width at Center (Gauge): 6 mm
- Gauge Length (Straight section): 33 mm
- Transition Radius: 14 mm
- Thickness: 4 mm

Requirements:
- The part must be symmetric about the X and Y axes.
- The geometry must be a single closed solid.
- Save the result to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/tensile_specimen.FCStd'.
